source.name: Chapter 6: 6.1 Knowledge Check - sub-agent description

answers.answer: A comment that Rasa ignores at runtime
A label shown to users when they start the conversation
The name of the flow that calls the sub-agent
The sub-agent's system prompt: the LLM reads it at runtime to understand what to do, in what order, and when to finish

source.guidance: The description is passed directly into the sub-agent's prompt. It controls how the LLM reasons, which tools it calls, and when it calls `task_completed`. Vague descriptions produce vague behaviour.
